title: PassThrough
description: Click through players to place blocks. Whitelist-based entity hitbox passthrough.
body:
# PassThrough

Click through players to place blocks. Cobwebs, F&S, whatever you add to the whitelist.

## How it works

Hold a whitelisted item, right-click through entities like they're not there. The mod ignores their hitboxes during raytrace so you can place blocks behind them.

**Smart Attack:**
Left-click still registers hits. The passthrough suspends when you're attacking so you can fight normally.

## Setup

Supports **[OneConfig](https://modrinth.com/mod/oneconfig)**.

Open the OneConfig menu or type `/passthrough` in the chat to:

* Toggle the mod on/off
* Edit your whitelist (supports typing item IDs or pasting bulk imports from clipboard)
* Configure attack behavior

The whitelist editor accepts registry names (`minecraft:web`) or numeric IDs (`30`).
Import button takes comma/newline separated lists.

## Disclaimer

**Use at your own risk.** Not responsible for server bans or rule violations.

This mod currently only supports Forge 1.8.9
